subject.title: Feature: config option to route gateway lifecycle warnings to a dedicated channel

question: Should OpenClaw add a general messages-level internal-warning destination/category router, and what categories and defaults should it support relative to existing suppression controls?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear in source, but choosing a public config contract for lifecycle, tool-error, system, cron, and maintenance diagnostics changes user-visible failure visibility.

options.title: Approve default-compatible router
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system/maintenance warnings while preserving current active-channel visibility by default.

options.title: Keep suppression-only controls
options.body: Treat messages.suppressToolErrors and narrower channel fixes as the supported operator path and close or narrow routing requests after maintainer confirmation.

options.title: Split warning classes
options.body: Track lifecycle, tool errors, cron, and session-maintenance warnings as separate policy issues instead of one shared router.

recommendation.title: Approve default-compatible router
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in router for lifecycle, tool-error, and system/maintenance warnings while preserving current active-channel visibility by default.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged history on warning-policy and adjacent delivery behavior.
